pageRules.pageFile: One file per page in src/content/pages/. home.json is the home page (/); every other file is named after its one-segment path (services.json is /services). Paths are lowercase words joined by hyphens, one level deep, and each is used once.

pageKeys.rule: "/" or a one-segment path like "/services". Must match the file name.
The page's search-result title, 1 to 80 characters.
The page's search-result description, 1 to 200 characters.
Where the page appears in the menu: { label, order, places }.
The page's sections, in order: at most 20.

menuKeys.rule: The words in the menu, 1 to 24 characters.
A number; lower numbers come first.

blockKeys.rule: The name of a block in this catalog.
One of the block's variants; the first is used when it is left out.
A lowercase name (letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter; at most 40 characters) that links can point to as /page#name. Unique on the page.
The block's fields, as listed in its entry.

status.live: The page is built, listed in the menu places it asks for, and in the sitemap.
status.archived: The page leaves the build, the menu and the sitemap. The file and its content stay, and setting it back to live restores it. A link to an archived page fails the check.

menu.rule: A page appears in the menu only if it has a menu entry. At most 6 live pages may be in the header.

pageRules.firstBlock: The first block must be a block whose position is "first" (the hero). It carries the page's one H1, so a page has exactly one.
pageRules.focalAnimation: At most one block per page may carry a signature (focal) animation.
pageRules.text: Text is plain. Only **bold** and [[placeholder]] marks are allowed. No HTML tags, no HTML entities, no markdown links and no control characters (line breaks, tabs, hidden characters).

allowed: An internal path (/name) or a path with an anchor (/name#anchor) that points to a live page, and to an anchor that exists on it.
"@booking": the site's booking link (the scheduler when set, otherwise /contact#book).

images.rule: An image is { src, alt } with an optional focus: center, top, bottom, left or right. The file must exist under /images/ and be a jpg, png or webp. Each image slot has a shape (3:2, 4:3, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9) and the picture is cropped to it; focus says which part to keep. The alt text must really describe the picture, so it can't be empty or only a generic word.

files.rule: A link may point to a PDF under /files/ that exists, such as /files/price-sheet-k3x9q2mz.pdf. Visitors download it.

video.rule: A video address must be from YouTube or Vimeo. The player is rebuilt from the video's id, not from the address that was pasted. Allowed player origins: https://www.youtube-nocookie.com, https://player.vimeo.com, https://open.spotify.com, https://embed.podcasts.apple.com.

audio.rule: An episode address must be from Spotify or Apple Podcasts. The player is rebuilt from the episode's id, not from the address that was pasted.

collections.slug: Lowercase words and digits joined by hyphens, 1 to 60 characters. It is the file name and, for a post, the address (/blog/<slug>).
collections.status: Every item has a status: draft (built only outside production), live, or archived (never shown, never deleted).

fields.name: order
fields.label: Order
fields.help: Lower numbers come first.

collections.sort: By the item's order number (lower first), then by its name.

photo.alt: A tall blue jug beside two small cups on a table

business.description: The business details every page can show: name, phone, email, address, hours and social links.

fields.name: name
fields.rule: The business name, up to 80 characters.

fields.name: phone
fields.rule: A phone number: 7 to 20 digits, spaces and + ( ) - . only. "" for none.

fields.name: address
fields.rule: Up to 4 address lines, each up to 80 characters. [] for none.

fields.name: hours
fields.rule: null (no hours shown) or all seven days (monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday), each "closed" or { "opens": "09:00", "closes": "17:00" } in 24-hour time, closing after opening.

fields.name: hoursNote
fields.rule: A note under the hours, up to 120 characters.

fields.name: social
fields.rule: Up to 8 links, each { "network", "url" }. Networks: instagram, facebook, linkedin, youtube, tiktok, x, pinterest, threads. The address must be https:// and on that network's own site.

brand.description: The colors, fonts and logo. src/app/palette.css and src/lib/fonts.ts are generated from it (npm run sync:config); never edit them by hand.

colorRoles.rule: The brand color is `green`; its five companions are derived from it, keeping their lightness and softness and taking its hue.
Text and background colors that Huston Logic sets; they are not changed by chat.

brand.contrastRule: Every foreground and background pair the design puts together must keep its contrast: 15 text pairs need 4.5 to 1, and 7 pairs (large text, icons, control edges, the focus ring) need 3 to 1. A color that fails is refused with the nearest one that works.
brand.fontRule: Each role takes one of its listed fonts, by id. The first of each role is the template default.

logo.rule: null (the business name is shown as text) or { src, alt, width, height }: an uploaded photo like /images/uploads/k3x9q2mz.webp with real alt text, at least 160 by 80 pixels, between square and 6 times wider than tall.

notice.description: A one-line notice above the header, with an optional link and last day.

fields.name: text
fields.rule: The notice, up to 120 characters. "" for no notice.

fields.name: link
fields.rule: { label, href }: the link words (up to 40 characters) and a link (see Page rules). It needs notice text.

fields.name: endsOn
fields.rule: The last day it shows, YYYY-MM-DD, or null for no end date.
